breaking_news.headline: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
breaking_news.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

breaking_news.headline: How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls
breaking_news.summary: Critics say the tech entrepreneur's enormous wealth has given him too much political power. But when stacked up against other notable American moguls, historians say he's not unique.

breaking_news.headline: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
breaking_news.summary: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

breaking_news.headline: Candy prices got you scared stiff? What to know about the cost of Halloween this year
breaking_news.summary: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year and are up more than 18% in two years, according to the latest federal data.

breaking_news.headline: The two most interesting risks to Anthropic
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic gave a 94-page list of risk factors in its S-1 this week. Two of them stood out.

breaking_news.headline: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted

breaking_news.headline: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

breaking_news.headline: Hackers steal over $6 billion from crypto exchange Binance in staggering heist
breaking_news.summary: More than $6 billion worth of cryptocurrencies were stolen from Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange. It's the biggest cyber heist ever — and many suspect North Korea may be behind it.

breaking_news.headline: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
breaking_news.summary: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.

breaking_news.headline: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
breaking_news.summary: Óscar Puente has been facing calls to resign after two high-speed trains collided earlier in the week, killing at least 69 people.

breaking_news.headline: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
breaking_news.summary: Novaya Gazeta has been one of the most high-profile independent news outlets in Russia over the last three decades.

breaking_news.headline: Police deployed during stand-off over control of top Poland court
breaking_news.summary: The escalation came after the government suspended two senior justices and moved to bring criminal charges against them.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of people are also understood to have stayed in the front-line town, despite the dangers.

breaking_news.headline: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
breaking_news.summary: It is Pike's first public statement since she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection in September.

breaking_news.headline: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: The American-made interceptors are the only effective weapon for downing Russia's ballistic missiles.

breaking_news.headline: Yorkshire Water boss resigns after firm downgraded
breaking_news.summary: Nicola Shaw, who has led the company since 2022, will step down in January, it is announced.

breaking_news.headline: From Levi's to Primark - the fashion chains selling mended clothes
breaking_news.summary: A new generation is embracing eye-catching patching and visible mends.

breaking_news.headline: How video game remakes tap the power of nostalgia
breaking_news.summary: Video games are good at triggering nostalgia, a key reason why classic games keep getting remade.

breaking_news.headline: How Poundland grew from a market stall to a high street giant
breaking_news.summary: The retail giant - which started life at a Wolverhampton market - is now at threat of collapse.

breaking_news.headline: City of London chief tops UK Black Powerlist
breaking_news.summary: Ian Thomas, who heads the City of London Corporation, tops the Black Powerlist in its 21st year.
